summary.plain: The KLOE particle detector at DAΦNE: a 4-metre drift chamber inside a lead-and-scintillating-fibre calorimeter that recorded the decays of phi mesons, later upgraded for KLOE-2 with a cylindrical inner tracker of GEM foils.
summary.technical: KLOE: 4 m-diameter drift chamber surrounded by a lead-scintillating-fibre electromagnetic calorimeter; KLOE-2 upgrades include a cylindrical gas-electron-multiplier (GEM) inner tracker, the first high-energy use of cylindrical GEMs (CERN Courier); tracker described in NIM A488 (2002) 51.

technology.quote: The general-purpose KLOE detector, comprising a 4 m-diameter drift chamber surrounded by a lead-scintillating-fibre electromagnetic calorimeter with very good energy and timing performance at low energies
technology.value: 4 m-diameter drift chamber surrounded by a lead-scintillating-fibre electromagnetic calorimeter; KLOE-2 added a cylindrical GEM inner tracker
